pain_points.statement: Finance is three weeks behind on invoicing due to data discrepancies between systems, leaving approximately $1.4M stuck in unbilled receivables.
pain_points.source_excerpt: finance is 3 weeks behind on invoicing because the data never lines up.

desired_state.statement: Establish a predictable, milestone-based consulting engagement within budget to resolve core financial and operational bottlenecks.
desired_state.source_excerpt: I'll give you a fixed-fee proposal with milestone payments tied to specific outcomes

success_criteria.statement: Achieve an industry-standard 5-day DSO to unlock $1.4M in working capital currently tied up in unbilled receivables.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: a return to five-day DSO from where we are now frees up about $1.4M in working capital

risks_unknowns.statement: Stakeholders disagree on the total Phase 1 budget limit and available funding.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Rita: Marcus, the budget I approved is $300,000. That's the cap. / Sarah: Rita, that's not what we discussed. We discussed a six-month Phase 1 in the $250 to $400 range
risks_unknowns.contradiction_note: Rita insists on a hard cap of $300,000 for Phase 1, whereas Sarah recalled a approved range of $250,000 to $400,000.

pain_points.statement: The custom dispatch platform (Routemaster) suffers from heavy technical debt and a fragile codebase, hindering feature development.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Technical debt in Routemaster. We can't ship features anymore because the codebase is too fragile.

desired_state.statement: Leadership disagrees on whether to fix existing workflows incrementally or completely replace the dispatch platform.
desired_state.source_excerpt: Sarah thinks this is a workflow problem. I think this is a platform problem. Routemaster is seven years old... and it's at the end of its useful life.
desired_state.contradiction_note: Marcus wants to spend $600k in Year 1 to replace Routemaster with a SaaS solution, while Sarah wants incremental workflow fixes built on top of the existing platform within a lower budget.

success_criteria.statement: Ensure architectural design isolates workflow logic so 60-70% of Phase 1 work is portable if Routemaster is replaced later.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: I'd estimate 60-70% of the Phase 1 work survives a platform change.

risks_unknowns.statement: Unclear technical overlap between deferred mobile driver app updates and mandatory ELD compliance work.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: The ELD work is in the driver app, which Alex just said he's deferring.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers face severe productivity losses due to extensive manual double-entry between Salesforce and the custom dispatch tool.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Too much manual entry between our custom dispatch tool and Salesforce

desired_state.statement: Streamline dispatcher workflows and fix upstream data generation to automate invoicing reconciliation.
desired_state.source_excerpt: focus on the invoicing reconciliation first... and then the dispatcher workflow because it's the upstream cause

success_criteria.statement: Reduce dispatch time per load by 30%, preventing the need to hire 4 additional dispatchers next year ($320k savings).
success_criteria.source_excerpt: a 30% reduction in dispatch time means we don't need to hire four additional dispatchers next year, which is about $320k in fully-loaded comp.

risks_unknowns.statement: Operational teams are skeptical because two prior internal efforts to solve dispatcher workflow issues failed.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: We've tried internal projects to fix this exact thing twice and they both failed.

pain_points.statement: Rapid 40% business growth through acquisitions in 2024 has resulted in incomplete technology and operational integration.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Northwind grew 40% in 2024 by acquiring two smaller brokerages. Tech integration from those acquisitions is incomplete.

desired_state.statement: Leadership disagrees on the target delivery schedule for the initial pilot deployment.
desired_state.source_excerpt: Sarah: We have a Q3 pilot commitment. / Marcus: Q3 was your commitment, not mine. I never agreed to Q3. I think Q4 is more realistic
desired_state.contradiction_note: Sarah and Rita require a Q3 pilot deployment to prevent funding reallocation, while Marcus believes a Q4 deadline is necessary for realistic implementation.

success_criteria.statement: Deliver a production pilot by end of Q3 (September 30) to secure executive support and retain capital allocation.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: If we don't have something in production by end of September, the funding gets reallocated. That part isn't negotiable.

risks_unknowns.statement: An impending November 15 federal ELD compliance mandate could risk state operating authority if not properly addressed.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: The ELD compliance deadline in November is real... Fines, possibly losing our operating authority in some states.
